description: Per-pixel delta shadows XR-07 smoke (developer build: -Asi Release\ApexRadiance.asi). Needs the bridge pair of patch 0019 and the x64 d3d9.dll of native/dxvk in Bin. Real-Time Lighting on with pixelShadows, the filtered mask view and the test capsule (no Sim capsules before XR-08): the open is answered on, passes run with rays and no fault through a 60 s pan. Pass: no crash, the On line, a counters line with passes and rays above 0 and faults=0, no off or error line.
